texts.zh:
结束了！叛乱基本已经被粉碎，而全帝国忠诚的子民们则在欢庆我们的胜利。

现在那些叛徒们已经束手就擒，我们得想想怎么料理他们。我们是要对他们网开一面还是让他们得到应有的惩罚呢？
texts.en:
It is done! The rebellion has been utterly crushed, and loyal citizens throughout the Imperium are celebrating our victory.

Now that the traitors have been brought to heel, we must decide how to deal with them. Should we show leniency or are they to be punished for their crimes?

label.en: Let us welcome them back into the Imperium.

label.zh: 他们应当为傲慢无礼付出代价。
label.en: They must be punished for their insolence.

texts.zh:
内战结束了！星海帝国的联合军队以迅雷不及掩耳之势击溃了叛国者们，星系恢复了往日的秩序。

当忠诚的帝国子民庆祝这场胜利时，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]决定采取宽容和解的政策。也许这种仁慈将会将过去的叛国者完全感化为忠诚而有用的帝国成员。
texts.en:
The civil war is over! Order has been restored to the galaxy, with the combined forces of the Galactic Imperium delivering swift justice to the rebel traitors.

As loyal Imperial citizens celebrate this victory, the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has decided to adopt a policy of leniency and reconciliation. Perhaps this kindness will eventually turn the former rebels into loyal and productive members of the Imperium.

texts.zh:
内战结束了！星海帝国的联合军队以迅雷不及掩耳之势击溃了叛国者们，星系恢复了往日的秩序。

我们获悉，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]决定要给叛徒们来个杀鸡儆猴。[gal_emperor.Capital.GetName]举行了一场空前盛大的胜利大游行，而在游行的尾声，被活捉的叛军头目们则被公开执行死刑并向全帝国直播。
texts.en:
The civil war is over! Order has been restored to the galaxy, with the combined forces of the Galactic Imperium delivering swift justice to the rebel traitors.

We have learned that the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] is determined to make an example of the rebels. A victory parade of unprecedented scale is to be held on [gal_emperor.Capital.GetName], and at its conclusion the mass execution of the surviving rebel leadership will be broadcast throughout the Imperium.

texts.zh:
这是星系的黑暗一日。尽管我们进了最大的努力，但我们的义举在帝制派面前仍然不堪一击。帝国的军队全线胜利，我们除了投降别无选择。

我们恢复了作为星海帝国一员的身份，但[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]显然采取了宽容和解的政策。我们不会再受到进一步的处罚。
texts.en:
It is a dark day for the galaxy. Despite our best efforts, the rebellion proved unable to withstand the onslaught of the Imperial loyalists. The forces of the Imperium prevailed on all fronts, and we have been left with no choice but to surrender.

Our status as a member of the Galactic Imperium has been restored, but the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has apparently adopted a policy of leniency and reconciliation. We are not to be punished further.

texts.zh:
这是星系的黑暗一日。尽管我们进了最大的努力，但我们的义举在帝制派面前仍然不堪一击。帝国的军队全线胜利，我们除了投降别无选择。

我们恢复了作为星海帝国一员的身份，但[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]显然决定要杀鸡儆猴给一度同叛军为伍的谋反分子看。在[gal_emperor.Capital.GetName]举行的一场空前盛大的胜利大游行的尾声中，被活捉的叛军头目即所有的起义首领被公开执行死刑，而整个活动是向全帝国直播的。
texts.en:
It is a dark day for the galaxy. Despite our best efforts, the rebellion proved unable to withstand the onslaught of the Imperial loyalists. The forces of the Imperium prevailed on all fronts, and we have been left with no choice but to surrender.

Our status as a member of the Galactic Imperium has been restored, but the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has apparently decided to make an example of everyone who sided with the rebels. All Rebel leaders will be executed at the conclusion of the Imperial victory parade on [gal_emperor.Capital.GetName] - an event that is to be broadcast throughout the Imperium.

texts.zh: 看起来星海帝国已经成功地撑过了它所面临的暴动风波。叛军已经被帝国军队完全击败，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]宣告在内战中获胜。
texts.en: It would seem that the Galactic Imperium has managed to weather the storm of insurrection it was facing. The rebels have been decisively defeated by Imperial forces, and the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has proclaimed victory in the civil war.

texts.zh:
尽管帝国军队未能摧毁叛乱，他们至少设法阻止了叛军想推翻[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的企图。有了这项和平条约，星海帝国的所有反叛分子都被保障了独立。

也许这是最好的结果。这样的疾病必须要在腐烂开始扩散之前斩除，因为我们总有机会重新吧这些任性的恒星系收归回帝国的怀抱……
texts.en:
While Imperial forces failed to destroy the insurgency, they at least managed to thwart the Rebels' attempt to overthrow the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]. With this peace treaty, all of the rebelling members of the Galactic Imperium have been granted independence.

Perhaps it is for the best. A disease such as this must be cut out before the corruption has a chance to spread. We can always rebuild and return these wayward systems to the bosom of the Imperium at a later date...

texts.zh:
尽管我们没有达成推翻[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的目的，但至少我们为自己的人民争得了自由。有了这项和平条约，星海帝国的所有起义分子都被保障了独立。

[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]毫无疑问会利用这个间隙重建帝国的军队，我们必须时刻提防帝国今后任何企图扩大影响力的尝试。
texts.en:
While we have failed in our attempt to overthrow the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], we have at least secured freedom for our own people. With this peace treaty, all of the rebelling members of the Galactic Imperium have been granted independence.

The [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] will no doubt use this respite to rebuild the Imperium's forces - we must guard against any future attempts by the Imperials to spread their influence at our expense.

texts.zh:
内战在僵局中结束了，虽然证明了帝国无法战胜叛乱，但叛军推翻[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的企图也失败了。

在今天由双方签署的和平条约中，帝国的起义成员被获得了完全的独立。我们将会看到这是否会导致两个权力集团的长久和平……或是冷战。
texts.en:
The Civil War has ended in stalemate. While the Imperium proved unable to vanquish the rebellion, the Rebels also failed in their attempt to overthrow the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle].

In a peace treaty signed by both parties today, the rebelling members of the Imperium were granted full independence. We shall see if this results in a lasting peace between the two power blocs... or a cold war.
